label: 2x2 component ablation: M-step repulsion x E-step recentring, with prototype geometry
config: k=16, EM seed 0, detector seed 0, 108 val tiles, alpha=0.3/kappa=1.6/thr=0.25
headline: Collapse is caused by the M-step repulsion alone (effective rank ~11 at beta=0 under BOTH E-steps, ~1.7 at beta=0.5 under both). Accuracy is driven mainly by the E-step recentring (+0.047..+0.049 crown IoU vs +0.035 for repulsion), and the two are substitutes (interaction -0.034..-0.037). Given recentring, the repulsion adds +0.0010 (oracle) and -0.0005 (predicted) -- a tie. So the non-collapsed configuration (beta=0 + recentring, rank 11.43) matches the deployed collapsed one (rank 1.66) on accuracy.
caveat: Single EM seed and single detector seed, on val. The ties are far inside any plausible noise band but a band has not been measured for these cells. alpha/kappa were also selected on val using the beta=0.5 masker and may not be optimal for beta=0.
